integrity: The primary paper was inspected at Theorems 7.4 and 7.5 and Example 7.6. The key new step is an exact kernel computation for the parallel normal form, followed by a span comparison that proves vanishing of the extra class is equivalent to equality of nets. The symbolic checker verifies the polynomial identities but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the algebraic ambiguity conditional on two quadrangles having the same locus and sharing a parallel bisector pair. It does not claim that every scalar in the ambient ambiguity line is geometrically realizable, and it does not classify all quadrangles with a prescribed locus.
title: Exact one-dimensional ambiguity for parallel-pair reconstruction of quadrangle nets
